response.sql:
WITH per_currency AS (
  SELECT feecoin, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebtotal, AVG((rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_relative_gap
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY feecoin
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rebtotal) AS mean_currency_avg_rebtotal
  FROM per_currency
)
SELECT AVG(p.avg_rebtotal) AS avg_rebate_above_benchmark,
       AVG(p.avg_relative_gap) AS avg_relative_gap_above_benchmark,
       AVG(p.avg_rebtotal - b.mean_currency_avg_rebtotal) AS avg_excess_above_benchmark
FROM per_currency AS p
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE p.avg_rebtotal > b.mean_currency_avg_rebtotal;

assumptions.assumption: A missing fee currency forms one NULL group, and the benchmark averages only non-missing per-currency average rebates, as SQL AVG skips NULLs.
